false_positive_risks: The rolling 3/3 MECHANISM window could become a prestige or throughput target if the one-in-three floor is misread; current Analyst explicitly rejects that interpretation.
preformal_eligible=true in principle could still be misread as positive evidence rather than lane admissibility; explicit transition provenance and NOT_READY semantics currently prevent this.

false_negative_risks: A future READY checklist could become a hidden second Formal gate if comparator/reduction/falsifier are interpreted as already won; no READY case exists yet.
Mechanism priority could suppress integrity-critical SYSTEM work if the prospective exception path is ignored; no such suppression is currently observed.
Repeated negative mechanism reductions must remain object-local and not be generalized into a topic-family no-go theorem; current fresh-successor semantics preserve this.
A 3/3 rolling mechanism window must not become an expectation that crowds out high-value SYSTEM/testbed work; current next-selection guidance correctly returns to information gain.
